{{Quote|The Mystics are never wrong.|Shanatka-Lo|<ref name="Bloody" />}}
'''Shanatka-Lo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the [[Voss|same name]] well before the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]], Shanatko-Lo [[Death/Legends|died]] sometime before [[3640 BBY]], and their [[Force ghost/Legends|ghost]] remained within the [[Shrine of Healing]] on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] alongside the spirits of fellow Mystics [[Laeras-Wu]] and [[Hanar-Ye]] to teach [[The Force/Legends|Force rituals]] to other Mystics and healers. Shanatka-Lo and the others taught the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Fulminiss]] a [[Voss healing ritual|healing ritual]] at the request of the Mystic [[Valen-Da]], and though Fulminiss corrupted the ritual with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]], the three dead Mystics remained confident in the wisdom of their fellow Mystic.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Who are you?''"<br />"''Ancient Mystics of Voss. Bound to this shrine for eternity. Wisdom endures through us.|The Hero of Tython and Shanatka-Lo|<ref name="Bloody" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Shanatka-Lo was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. Like all Voss who lived before the planet's discovery during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Shanatka-Lo spent their life on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]; as they were Force-sensitive, they became a [[Voss Mystics|Mystic]] who was capable of [[Force vision/Legends|seeing the future]]. Shanatka-Lo [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="Bloody" /> well before [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> but their [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] remained tied to the [[Shrine of Healing]] on Voss along with the spirits of fellow Mystics [[Hanar-Ye]] and [[Laeras-Wu]]. The three spirits shared their knowledge with visiting Mystics and healers, including the secrets of a [[Voss healing ritual|healing ritual]] that could heal the mind of a patient by drawing on the strength of many.<ref name="Bloody" /> In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] 3640 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> during the [[Galactic War]] between the Republic and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire, the Mystic [[Valen-Da]] visited the Shrine with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Fulminiss]].<ref name="Bloody" />

Because it was decreed by a Mystic, Shanatka-Lo and the others taught Fulminiss the healing ritual, though the Sith corrupted the ritual with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] so that it tore open the minds of its victims, and they watched as Fulminiss used the ritual against the healers who had accompanied Valen-Da. Valen-Da and Fulminiss then departed the Shrine, though the three ghosts saw Valen-Da leave a [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] in the corner of the chamber with a message for the [[Voss commandos|commando]] [[Tala-Reh]]. When the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] arrived at the Shrine in search of Valen-Da not long afterward, Shanatka-Lo and the other two Mystic spirits witnessed the deranged healers attack the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and forced the Knight to kill them in self-defense. The Mystics then appeared to the Jedi, explained what Fulminiss had done with the ritual, and faded away after informing the Knight of Valen-Da's message for Tala-Reh.<ref name="Bloody" />

==Personality and traits==
Shanatka-Lo possessed the [[Color/Legends|blue]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and red skin with blue patterns that all female Voss did, and lacked [[Hair/Legends|hair]] like the rest of their [[Species/Legends|species]]. As a spirit, Shanatka-Lo appeared as a ghostly yellow apparition, and they retained the belief that the wisdom of the Mystics was infallible even after death.<ref name="Bloody" />

==Equipment==
As a Force ghost, Shanatka-Lo wore Mystic [[Robe/Legends|robes]] that were white and blue in color.<ref name="Bloody" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shanatka-Lo first appeared in the Jedi Knight-class mission "Bloody Pilgrimage" on the planet Voss in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Bloody" />
